title_zh: 错开医院探视让家人休息

scenario.goal_zh: 避免多人同时探视并照顾陪护者

context_zh: 兄妹在医院协调探视时间，避免多人同时进入病房。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Dad has finally fallen asleep. Can we talk quietly out here?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Of course. Would it be better if I came back later?

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Yes. He needs some peace, and Mum is arriving in a few minutes.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I will come at four, after Mum leaves. You have been here all morning. Can you rest while she sits with him?

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: I will go home for an hour. Thanks for coming later instead of joining us all at once.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: No problem. I will see you at four unless you text me to change it.
